mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts below 1.5 million units signals weakening residential investment, which reduces construction-related demand and corporate capital expenditure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and a rise in the unemployment rate signals a contraction in manufacturing output and labor market stress, indicating an imminent economic slowdown that depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 60% of interaction-triggered instances, or the joint signal fails to outperform a baseline model in 3-year walk-forward tests.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above $680 billion signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPI inflation rate above 2.5% per year, combined with a stable federal funds rate, signals that inflation is outpacing monetary policy response, increasing real interest rate risk and reducing equity valuation multiples, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: inflationary pressure with delayed policy response
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 55% of interaction-triggered instances, or the joint signal has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP growth below 1.0% annualized, as measured by GDPC1, signals a weakening economy, which reduces corporate investment and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous drop in non-farm payrolls and a rise in the unemployment rate signals a labor market deterioration, which reduces household income and consumer spending, leading to lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 55% of interaction-triggered instances, or the joint signal fails to achieve a Rank IC above 0.04 in any 2-year walk-forward window.
